resources.string: Start capture, navigate to Default apps → Browser in system Settings, then return to ListCleaner and tap the eye icon again. Only Activity/Fragment metadata is recorded for 3 minutes. No screen contents are read.
No Settings page captured yet. Check the LSPosed scope for Settings and PermissionController, and reopen the actual page.
Captured pages (newest first). Tap one to try opening its actual Activity.
This Activity cannot be launched externally or requires internal state. Its identity is still available for diagnostics.
Allow display over other apps to use the floating capture button
Tap the floating icon to start/pause capture; hold to close
The icon starts in capture mode. Tap to pause/resume, drag to move, hold to close. Green check and a toast confirm a saved Activity/Fragment.
